Circuit 
 breaker must be
 isolated and proper earthing at two sides of CB is required.

Interrupt
 remote control and motor circuits (this achieved by receiving the multi-pin
 plug at the left hand side at the operating mechanism)

Switch breaker
 ON and OFF manually in order to discharge the closing and springs.

Measure dimension "E" with depth gauge from the stud (5-5) to the rim of the 
 dash pot housing figure 1

Loosen locking-nut (5-6) figure 4 and relieve dash
 pot of the load by rotating the spindle (5-7) in an anti-clockwise direction see figure 2
Dismantle stud (5-5) and remove the dash pot (5-4)
Replace with new dash pot (5-4) and fil stud (5-5)

Load dash pot by rotating spindle (5-7) in a clockwise direction until 
 dimension "E" figure 1 is obtained secure with lock-nut
 (5-6) tightening torque 77 Nm
